⚪ **Severity: LOW**

Out-of-bounds shared-memory read: `s_counters` is a 3-element array (indices 0-2), allocated with `s_lru_out = reinterpret_cast<int16_t*>(s_counters + 3)`. Accessing `s_counters[3]` reads into `s_lru_out` territory, reinterpreting two `int16_t` LRU slot indices as one `int32_t`. This corrupts the hit counter with arbitrary data from the adjacent buffer.
Helpful? Add 👍 / 👎

<details>
<summary>💡 Fix Suggestion</summary>

**Suggestion:** Replace `s_counters[3]` with `s_counters[1]` on line 536. The `s_counters` array only has 3 elements (indices 0-2): hits, phase-1 resolved, and valid count. Accessing index 3 reads into the adjacent `s_lru_out` buffer. Based on the surrounding code (line 529 shows `total_misses = top_k - total_hits - s_counters[1]`), the intent is to add phase-1 resolved tokens (`s_counters[1]`) to the hit counter for telemetry, since those tokens were already resident in the hot buffer.

> **⚠️ Experimental Feature**: This code suggestion is automatically generated. Please review carefully.

```suggestion
              static_cast<unsigned long long>(total_hits + s_counters[1]));
```

</details>

This repository is configured for manual code reviews. Comment `@claude review` for a one-time review, or `@claude review always` to subscribe this PR to a review on every future push.

<sub>Tip: disable this comment in your organization's [Code Review settings](https://claude.ai/admin-settings/claude-code).</sub>
